source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 19:1 (the going-out file; the three months; this day)
claim_en: ba-chodesh ha-shelishi LE-TZET bene yisrael ('in the third month OF THE GOING-OUT of the sons of Israel... on this day they came to the wilderness of Sinai'): the going-out-of-the-sons-of-Israel dating-formula stands TWICE in the Torah (adjacency checked): the Sinai arrival here and AARON'S DEATH ('in the fortieth year of the going-out,' Num 33:38) — with the Kitzur's third Scripture-side: THE TEMPLE'S FOUNDATION ('in the four hundred eightieth year of the going-out,' Kings): the exodus as the calendar's zero for the wedding, the atoning death, and the house; the three months read by the Kitzur as the BRIDE'S WAIT ('the freed captive does not marry until three months — Israel, freed from Egypt's captivity, waited three months to the day of the Torah-giving, on which they were wedded to the Holy One'); and BA-YOM HA-ZE — 'on THIS day' (Rashi from the mirror: 'that the words of Torah be NEW to you, as if given TODAY'): the machine's own wire beneath it: 3:12's sign — 'you shall serve God ON THIS MOUNTAIN' — arrives at its mountain.

source: Rashi on Exod 19:2 (the mirror; Mekhilta); Minchat Shai on 19:2 (the Ramah's full-fulls)
claim_en: va-yachanu ba-midbar VA-YICHAN sham yisrael neged ha-har ('and they camped in the wilderness — and ISRAEL CAMPED [singular] before the mountain'): the verse pluralizes the camping and then REPEATS IT IN THE SINGULAR — and the singular camp-verb's Torah-census is exactly THREE (checked): ISAAC in the valley of Gerar (Gen 26:17), JACOB before Shechem (Gen 33:18), and ISRAEL — the whole nation — here: Rashi (from the mirror, the Mekhilta beneath him): 'AS ONE MAN, WITH ONE HEART — but all the other campings were in complaints and in quarrels': the two patriarchs who camped alone joined by a nation camping AS one; and the departure-word closes exo_17's spelling arc (asserted at the build): ME-REFIDIM full-with-both-yods, census-unique — the Ramah's roster: the Torah's only two full-full Rephidims are the ARRIVAL (17:1) and the DEPARTURE here, every other station lean — the name healed on the way out (Rashi: 'their departure from Rephidim was in repentance, like their arrival at Sinai').

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 19:3 (the ten-yod); Minchat Shai on 19:3 (the Ramah's rule; Lekach Tov; Shabbat)
claim_en: ko tomar le-vet yaaqov VE-TAGED li-vne yisrael ('so shall you SAY to the house of Jacob, and TELL the sons of Israel'): the tell-word written FULL with yod — and MS recites the rule: 'EVERY tell-form in the Torah is lean, EXCEPT THIS' (census-unique, checked) — the Kitzur on the surplus letter: the yod = THE TEN, 'that he should tell them the ten utterances'; Lekach Tov on the two verbs: 'SAY to the house of Jacob — THE WOMEN, gently, sweetening the commandments; TELL the sons of Israel — THE MEN, words hard as SINEWS (gidin)' — the full yod itself read as the sinew-word's letter; and the Talmud's pair carried (Shabbat, cited by MS): 'va-yashev — words that RESTORE a man's spirit; va-yaged — words hard as sinews': the one plene tell-form in the Torah standing at the mouth of Sinai, its extra letter carrying either the Ten or the toughness.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 19:4 (the four verse-head YOUs)
claim_en: ATEM reitem asher asiti le-mitzrayim ('YOU have seen what I did to Egypt, and I bore you on eagles' wings and brought you to Me'): the Kitzur's file of verse-opening YOUs — and the Torah's census is exactly THREE (checked, verse-initial): 'YOU — go, get yourselves straw' (5:11, Pharaoh's spite), 'YOU have seen' (the eagle-verse here), 'YOU are standing this day' (Deut 29:9) — with the file's fourth Scripture-side: 'YOU are My witnesses' (Isaiah): the Kitzur wiring the first pair: 'because Egypt would not give them straw — YOU HAVE SEEN WHAT I DID TO EGYPT'; and the last pair: 'because you are STANDING this day — forever you can be MY WITNESSES, for I stand forever': the second person plural marching from the brick-quota to the wings to the standing to the witness-stand.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 19:4 (the two lean comings); Kitzur Baal HaTurim on 19:4 (the betrothal)
claim_en: va-esa etkhem al-kanfe nesharim VA-AVI etkhem elai ('and I bore you on eagles' wings, and I BROUGHT YOU TO ME'): the brought-word written LEAN (no yod) — and its Torah-twin is the SERVANT AT THE WELL (census pair, checked): 'and I CAME this day to the spring' (Gen 24:42, Abraham's servant on the bridal errand): the Torah's two lean I-cames are BOTH COURTSHIPS — the emissary arriving to fetch Rebekah and the LORD carrying Israel home to Himself; and the Kitzur unrolls the wedding beneath it: 'as a wife is acquired by MONEY, by DOCUMENT, and by UNION — so Israel: the money, Egypt's spoil; the document, THE TORAH (read not morasha, heritage, but MEORASA, betrothed); the union — and-I-brought-you-to-Me' (the plene reading's arithmetic named as the tradition's own device; Hosea's threefold 'I will betroth you' sealing it): the covenant-offer of 19:5 arriving as a proposal in the marital sense before the legal one.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 19:5 (the finals); the treasure-census
claim_en: vi-heyitem li SEGULA mi-kol-ha-amim ('and you shall be to Me a TREASURE out of all the peoples'): the treasure-word's Torah-career exactly FOUR (census checked): the OFFER here and its three Deuteronomy RATIFICATIONS (am segula 7:6, 14:2; the mutual declaration 26:18) — proposed once at the mountain, confirmed three times on the plains; and the Kitzur's letter-fact beneath the phrase (asserted at the build): the FINAL LETTERS of li segula mi-kol ha-amim — yod, he, lamed, mem — are the letters of MILA ('circumcision,' rearranged): the treasured-people clause signing, in its word-ends, the covenant-mark already in the people's flesh (the corpus files the acrostic-class variant: an end-letter anagram, the third machine-era member after the two initials-crowns).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 19:6 (the priests' kingdom; the nation-file)
claim_en: ve-atem tihyu-li mamlekhet kohanim VE-GOY qadosh ('and you shall be to Me a kingdom of priests and a holy NATION'): the and-a-nation word stands ONCE in the Torah (checked) — and the Kitzur runs its Scripture-file as a CONDITIONAL: 'if you are the HOLY nation — then a nation that knew you not shall RUN to you (Isaiah); and if not — a great nation shall be ROUSED from the ends of the earth (Jeremiah, twice, on the destruction)': the one Torah ve-goy holding the fork between the nations that run toward and the nation that comes against; and the priests' kingdom read whole: 'had Israel merited, ALL OF THEM WOULD BE HIGH PRIESTS — and in the time to come it RETURNS to them, as it is said: and you shall be called THE PRIESTS OF THE LORD (Isaiah)': the corpus notes the machine's frame: the offer precedes the priesthood — for one chapter the whole nation holds the office Aaron's line will inherit.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 19:9 (the two full forevers)
claim_en: ve-gam bekha yaaminu LE-OLAM ('that the people may hear in My speaking with you — and ALSO BELIEVE IN YOU FOREVER'): the forever-word written FULL exactly TWICE in the Torah (census checked): the people's faith in Moses here — and the ban's clock: 'you shall not seek their peace or their good, all your days, FOREVER' (Deut 23:7, Ammon and Moab) — the Kitzur holding both faces: the midrash's mercy ('in the days of the Messiah, MOSES COMES, leading the wilderness generation with him' — the forever-believed prophet returning with his forever-generation) and the warning it sits beside (the two eternities: trust without end, and a door shut without end; the ten lean forevers asserted at the build): the corpus files the pair: what Sinai writes full lasts — in both directions.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 19:23 (the four lean ascents; the printer's omission caught)
claim_en: lo-yukhal ha-am LA-ALOT el-har sinai ('the people CANNOT COME UP to mount Sinai'): the ascend-word written LEAN — and MS walks the Masorah: FOUR lean TO-ASCENDs in the Torah: the two at SINAI'S FENCE ('the people cannot come up,' 19:23; 'let them not break through to come up,' 19:24) and the two at the SPIES ('you would not come up,' Deut 1:26; 'you made ready to come up,' Deut 1:41) — 'and THE PRINTER FORGOT TO WRITE THE FOURTH' (MS catching the printed Masorah's omission: the very list of failures shortened by one); the skeleton's Torah-census is five (checked) — the fifth is the NOUN, 'for the burnt-offering' (Num 28:23), riding the same letters: the corpus files the four lean verb-ascents whole: twice the mountain may not be climbed, twice the land was not climbed — permission withheld and nerve withheld, one thinned verb.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 19:13 (the stoning-pair; the drawn-out horn)
claim_en: ki-SAQOL YISAQEL o-yaro yiyare ('for he shall surely be STONED, or surely shot; whether beast or man, it shall not live'): the surely-stoned doubling stands exactly TWICE in the Torah (adjacency checked): the MOUNTAIN-TOUCHER here and the GORING OX ('the ox shall surely be stoned,' 21:28) — the Kitzur: 'from here we learn FOR THE GENERATIONS: as here by pushing and by stoning, so for the generations pushing and stoning' (the execution-protocol of the courts read out of Sinai's fence); bi-MESHOKH HA-YOVEL — 'when the RAM'S HORN draws out, THEY may come up': the drawn-out word Torah-unique (checked at the build) — its Scripture-twin JERICHO ('when the horn of the yovel draws out,' Joshua): the Kitzur: 'there too a shofar from ISAAC'S RAM was provided — and by the merit of the Torah-giving's shofar, Jericho's wall fell' (one ram, both horns: the mountain that opens and the wall that falls); the corpus notes the fence's own release-clause: the boundary-card carries its expiry in its text — at the long blast, the mountain becomes climbable.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 19:16 (the doubly-lean thunders; the Zohar cited); Kitzur Baal HaTurim on 19:16
claim_en: va-yehi QOLOT u-veraqim ('and there were THUNDERS and lightnings, and a heavy cloud on the mountain, and a shofar-voice exceedingly strong'): the thunders-word written DOUBLY LEAN (no vav in either slot) — and its Torah-census is exactly THREE (checked): THE HAIL, twice ('and the LORD gave THUNDERS and hail... entreat that there be no more THUNDERS OF GOD,' 9:23, 9:28) — and SINAI: one thinned skeleton from the plague-sky to the Torah-sky (the voices Pharaoh begged to stop are the voices Israel is summoned to hear; MS: 'one of the lean-of-the-lean — see the Zohar there'); BI-HEYOT ha-boqer — 'when the morning WAS': the being-word Torah-unique lean (checked at the build) — the Kitzur: 'for then SIX EONS WERE COMPLETE' (the missing vav = the six spent ages); and the cloud is KAVED — HEAVY (the machine's file: the root that ran Pharaoh's heart, Moses' hands, and Moses' caseload arrives at the Presence itself — the heavy cloud as the weight-word's homecoming, asserted in-span).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 19:19 (the strengthening pair; Eruvin)
claim_en: va-yehi qol ha-shofar HOLEKH VE-CHAZEQ meod ('and the voice of the shofar went on GOING AND STRENGTHENING exceedingly — Moses would speak, and God would answer him in a voice'): the going-and-strengthening pair stands ONCE in the Torah (adjacency checked) — its Scripture-twin DAVID ('and David went on GOING AND STRENGTHENING,' Samuel): the Kitzur from Eruvin: 'David, who REVEALED his tractate — of him it is written going and strengthening; Saul, who did not — going and poorer: and so THE TORAH, of which it is written going and strengthening exceedingly' (the open teacher and the growing voice one idiom); moshe YEDABER ve-ha-elohim YAANENU be-QOL — the corpus's only narrated STANDING DIALOGUE inside a theophany (the readings on 'He answered him ABOUT the voice' — named-only); and the letter-file's divergence FILED OPENLY: MS counts this verse's shofar among the NINE LEAN — the SNAPSHOT writes it FULL here and lean at 19:16 and 20:18 (the divergence observation recorded, tradition vs SNAPSHOT, the stream standing — the check anchors the adjacency, not the disputed skeleton).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 19:23 (the head-and-tail pair); Minchat Shai on 19:23-24
claim_en: hagbel et-ha-har VE-QIDASHTO ('fence the mountain, AND SANCTIFY IT'): the and-sanctify-him word stands exactly TWICE in the Torah (census checked) — and the Kitzur reads their PLACEMENT: here it ends its verse (the SNAPSHOT: verse-final, asserted at the build), and at the PRIEST it OPENS one ('AND YOU SHALL SANCTIFY HIM, for he offers the bread of your God,' Lev 21:8, verse-initial, asserted): 'the priest's sanctity is AT THE HEAD — to open first, to bless first, to take the first portion; the scholar's sanctity is AT THE END' (the two sanctifyings placed where their honor lives: the priest's up front, the learner's at the close — 'and the greatest of all rolls the scroll'); the chapter's remaining letter-file (MS): ha-EDOTA with a final He ('the tongues of warning,' Bachya cited); the segol under lekh-red's lamed; yifratz-BAM in the CLIPPED QAMATZ forced by the binder-stroke (Rashi's own note on it carried in the mirror); TIGSHU's dageshed gimel (checked at the build); and the DIVERGENCE FILED: the second ha-shelishi of 19:11 — MS with the Ramah: the Torah's ONE lean third-word; the SNAPSHOT writes both full (tradition vs SNAPSHOT observation, stream standing).
